name: GitHub Repository Provisioning Workflow
description: Parent-child workflow contract for autonomous repo provisioning

scripts.name: classify_risk.py
scripts.reason: Core governance logic - no child modifications allowed

scripts.name: modify_tfvars.py
scripts.purpose: Programmatic tfvars modification for business users
scripts.reason: Operational helper - can be extended by child

workflows.name: apply.yml
workflows.trigger: push to main or manual dispatch
workflows.reason: Core execution - must be consistent across all children

workflows.name: request-operation.yml
workflows.purpose: Business user interface for repo requests
workflows.reason: Business interface - can be customized per repo

governance.name: CODEOWNERS
governance.purpose: Define code ownership for approval routing

codeowners_check.action_if_missing: Flag in PR comment: ⚠️ CODEOWNERS missing (Tier 1 requires review)

versioning.update_strategy: Child auto-syncs to latest parent main (no locking)

tier_0_scenario.name: Auto-approve safe operation
tier_0_scenario.input: Create private repo with standard naming

tier_1_scenario.name: Manual review risky operation
tier_1_scenario.expected_action: PR waits for manual approval, CODEOWNERS flagged

codeowners_missing.name: CODEOWNERS detection
codeowners_missing.expected_action: PR comment: ⚠️ CODEOWNERS missing for Tier 1 review

contract_resolution.name: Child fetches from parent
contract_resolution.expected_action: Child reads contract, pulls classify_risk.py from parent@main
contract_resolution.expected_result: Classification works using parent's immutable rules
